prompt.text:
Implement `updateRoster(entries, changes)` in JavaScript.

`entries` must be an array of `{ id, name, score }` objects. Each `id` must be a unique non-empty string, `name` must be a string, and `score` must be a finite number. `changes` must be an array of `{ id, delta }` objects, where `id` identifies an existing entry and `delta` is finite.

Apply changes sequentially, so repeated changes for one ID all contribute in their original order. Return a new array in the original entry order. Every returned entry must be a new object, including when `changes` is empty. Throw `TypeError` for malformed values, `RangeError` for duplicate entry IDs or unknown change IDs, and validate everything before applying changes. Do not mutate either argument or any entry object.

Use CommonJS and export exactly `{ updateRoster }` with `module.exports`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
